deliberation: The successor is procedurally ready with conditions. It enforces rather than amends GI-STEWARD-0002, which makes jimsteeg non-mandatory for routine decisions. It replaces unscoped burden with closed classification while retaining required pre-merge checks, exact-SHA readback, expensive post-merge checks for relevant changes, and recovery for lost events or failures. Council does not authorize a proxy, approve or merge a pull request, alter protected settings, activate policy, ratify an amendment, certify mathematics, or exercise AETHER or MATHCERT authority.
discharged_obligations: Reconciled staffing, workflow burden, classification, recovery, and authority boundaries.
Confirmed routine jimsteeg removal follows current authority.
Preserved exact-SHA evidence and relevant post-merge checks.
Kept Council advice separate from Human Steward disposition and integration.
findings: The staffing correction is already required by effective authority.
Required pre-merge checks remain unchanged and cannot be bypassed by classification.
Every merge retains exact-SHA protected-target readback; only additional expensive suites are impact-gated.
Unknown, mixed, authority-sensitive, security-sensitive, protected-workflow, credential, AETHER-boundary, and MATHCERT-disposition changes require conservative treatment.
Routine jimsteeg requests must cease while optional and recovery roles remain bounded.
No Council record created here supplies proxy, merge, activation, ratification, certification, or escalation authority.
conditions: Enforce GI-STEWARD-0002 exactly: mandatory routine reviewers remain empty; jimsteeg is contacted only for exact recovery or separately named optional review.
Freeze and validate a closed classifier before runtime change; unknown, mixed, generator-affecting, dependency-widening, or invalid states select conservative fanout.
Retain all current required pre-merge checks and emit exact-SHA protected-target readback for every protected merge.
Replace generic fixed-delay work with event-driven readback plus scheduled recovery and manual escalation; retain a timer only for an enumerated risk contract.
Publish append-only classification, execution, readback, recovery, incident, and supersession evidence without treating not-applicable as passed.
Validate hostile stale-head, mixed-path, generator, lost-event, duplicate-event, replay, hold, ruleset-drift, and unauthorized-reviewer cases.

Require separate authenticated Human Steward disposition wherever effective authority reserves it; automation may prepare and validate but not approve, merge its own work, activate, ratify, certify, impersonate, or expand permissions.
Measure routine jimsteeg requests, human actions, fixed-delay jobs, false-lightweight classifications, incidents, and handling time; preserve rollback.
residual_uncertainty: The wider inventory may reveal a narrow exact policy requiring migration.
Shadow evidence is still required to measure false negatives.
Scheduled recovery cadence should follow event-loss data.
